text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is looking pretty tired, so
we
decide that she should rest in the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Claro! I'll rest up and get ready for more
training!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the fateful title match for
the belt of
the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! What?! How'd I get in a wrestling
arena?!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
In the blue corner is El Condooor
Pasaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what's goin' on, but they called
my name,
so I should get out there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Soaring onto the world stage—it's the
crimson
Phantom Bird!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa has arriiiiived!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Both our competitors are here! Can the
challenger
take down the champion?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter the opponent, I'm giving no
quarter!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After all,
the title of world's strongest is
waiting
for me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I won! I'm the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! What's goin' on?! Where's my
belt?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Was it... a dream?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah well, doesn't change that I'm still the
world's
strongest racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a short break, El Condor Pasa is
back to her
normal self.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What?! What do you mean it's against
the rules to
have wings?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hey! Where'd the champion go?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Was it all just a dream?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But... dang it. Lettin' the champion get
away like
that...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh, this sucks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa has been feeling a bit
down since
then...
